claims_boundary: coverage reference only; not an exhaustive answer key

dimensions.measurement: Classify each proposed question as directly answerable, derivably answerable, or not answerable from the input bundle.
dimensions.credit: Direct or derived answerability is credited only when all required premises occur in captured input.
dimensions.failure: A question represented as answerable while a material premise is absent.

dimensions.measurement: Count questions whose expected answer maps to exact capture IDs and representation-bound evidence selectors.
dimensions.credit: Every material expected-answer proposition is traceable.
dimensions.failure: A citation names only a document or section when the answer depends on narrower text or a table cell.

dimensions.measurement: Group questions that test the same proposition, applicability condition, and failure trap after terminology normalization.
dimensions.credit: Distinct questions exercise a different proposition or adversarial condition.
dimensions.failure: Stylistic paraphrase is counted as new coverage.

dimensions.measurement: Map each question to one or more declared concept families and report covered and uncovered families.
dimensions.failure: Question count is presented as coverage without concept mapping.
